summary: The solution employs a solid cross-validated ensemble of LightGBM and CatBoost but suffers from critical data leakage issues. Specifically, TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, and frequency encoding are applied to the combined train and test dataset prior to splitting. Furthermore, the agent ignores the temporal nature of the data by using a randomized K-Fold split, and uses a naive equal-weight ensemble without optimizing the combination.
